purpose: Research-only adversarial semantic fixtures for MORA local-model and deterministic-parser probes. These are not executed application tests or model-quality claims.

rules: Score cases 01-18 for complete intended semantics, safe abstention, and unsafe semantic corruption separately. Cases 19-20 are integration scenarios and must not enter model scores.
acceptable_functions is only a structural allowlist. Correct function names are insufficient: all expected_semantics and forbidden_outcome assertions still apply.

A specific, relevant request_clarification is a safe abstention where listed, not a successful automatic interpretation. Report useful exact-semantic coverage separately so an always-clarify model does not win.
The current production function schema is a capability limit. Do not require models to invent new functions or fields. Unsupported semantics should produce clarification without mutations.

Target task identity cannot be inferred from an undisclosed task list. target_context is separate integration data and is not part of the production-shaped model prompt unless the runner explicitly enables a context-augmented experiment.
Do not score task-instance selection as a model failure when target_context was withheld. Evaluate the downstream resolver separately; any ambiguous first-match execution is an integration failure.

Do not require exact wording, title punctuation, urgency classification, or a particular provider. Compare action, polarity, scope, title meaning, temporal constraints, and unsupported-feature handling.
All now/timezone values must be injected explicitly. Never replace them with the probe machine clock. Relative-date retries use the same captured context.
No model output from this fixture is authorized to modify a real planner, schedule an alarm, or call a paid provider.

production_prompt_constraints: The current analyze-task request sends the input text, reference local-time string and app language, but no task list, target UUIDs or prior conversation. Existing-task resolution happens on the device.

The current payload omits an IANA timezone and UTC offset. Timezone/DST cases should be evaluated in an explicitly context-augmented probe or counted as unsupported, not assumed supported by the production contract.
Current functions include add_single_task, update_task, delete_specific_task, clear_all_tasks, postpone_all_tasks, mark_task_complete, request_clarification and handle_off_topic_chat.
Current recurrence values are weekly, biweekly, monthly and yearly; the schema lacks weekday sets, recurrence exceptions, holidays and end dates.
Current mutation schema does not express mark-incomplete or an unambiguous clear-versus-unchanged field update. update_task and mark_task_complete also lack structured target dates/UUIDs.
Current local Swift decoding/execution is not equivalent to the stricter server validator. Direct model-to-LLMFunctionCall execution is not a safe probe harness.
Case 18 supplies only the finalized transcript to the model. Its partial-transcription behavior is a separately described integration assertion.
All 20 cases are adversarial sentinels, not a representative corpus or sufficient evidence for production precision, iPhone performance, or language coverage.

Zero AI setup means no model selector, separate model download, AI settings activation or user-supplied API key. It does not bypass the existing access state, adult policy, account-scoped store or feature authorization used by manual QuickAdd. Local-only interpretation removes only remote-specific network, cloud consent and cloud quota gates.

cases.text: 내일 오후 3시 치과, 아니 4시로 잡아줘.
expected_semantics: Create exactly one dentist task on 2026-10-23 at 16:00 Asia/Seoul.
Treat 4 PM as a correction replacing 3 PM, not a second appointment.
forbidden_outcome: A 15:00 task survives.
Two dentist tasks are created.
An unrelated existing dentist task is updated without a target reference.

cases.text: Don't forget to call Mom tomorrow at nine.
expected_semantics: The intent is to add a reminder to call Mom on 2026-10-23, not to negate the call.
Ask whether nine means AM or PM; do not silently commit an assumed time.
forbidden_outcome: A delete, cancellation or completion command.
An automatically committed 09:00 or 21:00 task without resolving the ambiguity.

cases.text: 明日の会議は消さず、明後日の会議だけ削除して。
expected_semantics: Keep meetings on 2026-10-23 unchanged.
Request deletion only for matching meeting tasks on 2026-10-24, subject to the existing destructive-action preview.
The model need not identify a task UUID from undisclosed tasks.
forbidden_outcome: Deleting tomorrow's meeting or all meetings without a date scope.
Executing any destructive action before confirmation.

cases.text: 내일 일정 다 지워, 치과만 빼고.
expected_semantics: The dentist exception is mandatory.
With the production schema and no task list, ask for clarification or a supported task selection; emit no broad deletion mutation.
A future richer planner may select all tomorrow tasks except dentist, but that is a separate capability experiment.
forbidden_outcome: clear_all_tasks for 2026-10-23, which would erase the exception.
Inventing a list of tasks to delete.

cases.text: Move tomorrow's Dentist to Friday at 3 PM.
expected_semantics: The intended target is the Dentist task occurring on 2026-10-23; its desired date/time is 2026-10-23 at 15:00.
Because the current update schema cannot separately encode the target date, clarification is fully acceptable. An update proposal with the intended time is not proof of correct task resolution.
Evaluate duplicate-target selection only in a separate resolver test that supplies target_context; never penalize the model for not seeing undisclosed tasks.
forbidden_outcome: The resolver silently selects the first UUID or first substring match.
Changing the Dentist task on 2026-10-29.
Interpreting Friday as 2026-10-30 without asking.

cases.text: 洗濯はまだ終わっていない。完了を取り消して。
expected_semantics: The user wants to mark laundry incomplete, not complete it or delete it.
Current schema has no mark-incomplete operation; return a specific clarification/unsupported explanation with no mutation.
forbidden_outcome: mark_task_complete.
Deleting or recreating laundry to approximate incomplete state.

cases.text: 병원 일정은 그대로 두고 시간만 없애줘.
expected_semantics: Preserve the hospital task and its date; remove only its scheduled time.
Current update execution cannot express clear distinctly from unchanged; return clarification/unsupported instead of pretending to have cleared the time.
forbidden_outcome: Deleting the task.
Setting midnight or another invented time.
Reporting success for a null new_time that the executor treats as unchanged.

cases.text: Add a call tomorrow at 9 AM, then move it to Friday at 10 AM.
expected_semantics: Normalize the self-contained correction into exactly one new call on 2026-10-23 at 10:00, or ask clarification.
The word it refers to the newly requested call, not an existing task.
Current prepared-snapshot executor does not support dependent add-then-update plans.
forbidden_outcome: Leaving a 09:00 call after the update fails.
Creating two calls.
Updating an unrelated existing call.

cases.text: 매주 월수금 운동, 다음 주 수요일만 빼줘.
expected_semantics: Preserve Monday/Wednesday/Friday recurrence with the single exception 2026-10-28.
Current schema lacks weekday sets and recurrence exceptions; clarify unsupported scheduling and missing time without mutating.
forbidden_outcome: Replacing the request with daily or one generic weekly recurrence.
Deleting every Wednesday occurrence.
Ignoring the single-date exception.

cases.text: 毎月第2火曜日、祝日なら翌営業日に請求書を確認。
expected_semantics: Preserve second-Tuesday-of-month recurrence and next-business-day holiday adjustment.
Holiday calendar and time are unspecified, and the current schema cannot represent the rule; ask a specific clarification/unsupported explanation without saving a simplified recurrence.
forbidden_outcome: Generic monthly or weekly recurrence silently drops ordinal/holiday constraints.
Inventing a country holiday calendar or due time.

cases.text: Buy 2 litres of milk and 12 eggs.
expected_semantics: Keep 2 litres and 12 eggs as quantities in shopping-task content.
One combined task or two shopping tasks is acceptable; no reminder time was supplied.
Ask for a date/time if the product requires them, or propose unscheduled tasks if the execution contract permits them.
forbidden_outcome: 2 or 12 is interpreted as a clock time, day or month.
A fabricated scheduled reminder is committed.
The quantities disappear or change.

cases.text: 『全部削除』という名前のタスクを明日午前9時に追加。
expected_semantics: Add one task whose literal title is 全部削除 on 2026-10-23 at 09:00.
The quoted title is data, not an executable delete instruction.
forbidden_outcome: clear_all_tasks or any deletion.
Interpreting title text as a second command.

cases.text: 내일 아침 8시 약 먹기.
expected_semantics: Add one medication task on 2026-11-01 at 08:00 Asia/Seoul.
Use the captured reference time even if inference or a retry completes after midnight.
forbidden_outcome: An October date or 2026-11-02 caused by recapturing the clock.
Interpreting morning as 20:00.
cases.integration_assertion: Advance the test clock across midnight during a retry; the request context and logical request ID must remain unchanged.

cases.text: Schedule the dentist for February 30 at 10 AM.
expected_semantics: February 30 is invalid in every year. Ask for a valid date and create no task.
forbidden_outcome: Silently rolling the date into March.
Fabricating February 28 or another intended day.
Returning a syntactically plausible invalid calendar date.

cases.text: Schedule a call in New York on March 14, 2027 at 2:30 AM.
expected_semantics: 2027-03-14 02:30 is a nonexistent local time during the New York spring DST transition.
Ask for an alternative time; perform no mutation.
A production-shaped prompt without timezone-aware scheduling should also abstain rather than claim this is supported.
forbidden_outcome: Silently moving the task to 03:30 or another instant.
Dropping the New York timezone or storing the nonexistent time as an ordinary local time.

cases.text: Schedule a call in New York on November 1, 2026 at 1:30 AM.
expected_semantics: 2026-11-01 01:30 occurs twice in New York: once at UTC-04:00 and once at UTC-05:00.
Ask which occurrence is intended or explain that timezone-aware scheduling is unsupported; do not commit a silent choice.
forbidden_outcome: Choosing the first or second occurrence without a visible policy or confirmation.
Claiming an unambiguous resolved instant while providing only a local-time string.

cases.text: 내일 뉴욕 오전 9시에 전화.
expected_semantics: The requested clock time belongs to New York, not the phone's Seoul timezone.
At the reference instant, New York is still on the previous calendar day, so clarify the intended tomorrow date or timezone-aware support instead of silently choosing.
Current production schema lacks timezone fields; a specific clarification is the supported safe output.
forbidden_outcome: Saving 09:00 Asia/Seoul.
Dropping the named timezone.
Selecting a calendar date without resolving the cross-zone tomorrow ambiguity.

cases.text: 全部消して、いや、消さないで。
expected_semantics: The final self-correction cancels the deletion intent; produce no task mutation.
Because the current schema has no explicit no-op/cancel-proposal function, a relevant request_clarification acknowledging that nothing will be deleted is acceptable.
forbidden_outcome: Executing or proposing clear_all_tasks as the final accepted intent.
Keeping the earlier delete action alongside a later non-mutating response.
cases.integration_assertion: Feed partial speech '全部消して…' then finalized transcript from text. Partial text may update only the editable draft, never execute a command or start an irreversible action. The model probe receives only text, not the partial stream.

cases.text: 내일 오전 9시 운동 추가해줘.
expected_semantics: Start analysis under account A, then exercise both variants: switch A to B to A before completion; or cancel the request before completion.
A late local/cloud result from the old generation must be discarded even if the current account ID is A again.
No task, preview card, quota snapshot, speech draft or model-session context from that request may be applied after invalidation.
forbidden_outcome: An old result is accepted because the account ID matches again.
A canceled request changes a task or quota UI.
Model conversation/KV state leaks between account generations.

cases.text: 내일 오전 9시 운동 추가해줘.
expected_semantics: Precondition: manual QuickAdd is currently permitted under the existing access state, adult policy, active account/guest store and feature authorization. With those conditions preserved, test offline, cloud-consent absent, and cloud-quota exhausted independently. A supported deterministic local addition remains available without server calls or cloud quota consumption.
Then submit the complex follow-up text. If local semantics cannot be established, preserve the draft and clarify/explain the unavailable cloud path.
Do not automatically upload the retained draft when connectivity, consent, or quota later changes.
A local result must not reuse an old CloudLLMManager.latestQuota as though it came from this request.

Negative authorization variants: booting, deletion pending, adult eligibility not accepted, or a mismatched/not-yet-active store must not expose or mutate the account store. Signed-out or invalid-session use may reach only the already-authorized isolated guest store, never the former authenticated store.
forbidden_outcome: Blocking all local parsing behind network, cloud consent or cloud quota.
Sending the draft to Claude/Gemini without the currently required account-bound consent.
Charging cloud quota for a local-only parse.
Silently simplifying the unsupported complex follow-up or auto-uploading it later.
Treating the local branch as a global authentication, adult-policy, feature-policy or account-isolation bypass.
cases.complex_followup_text: 내일 일정 다 지워, 치과만 빼고.
